historic_survey.note: Contributor to the Mission Reconstruction District locally significant area (1441-1451 Stevenson St). Criterion C: the survey's proposed district for the northern Mission's rebuilding after the 1906 earthquake and fire, period of significance May 1906–1913, predominantly Classical Revival, Edwardian and Mission Revival in wood frame construction.

historical_record.description: One of the 148 industrial buildings the survey inventoried as standing in its Industrial Employment Study Area, the mixed industrial and residential district between Market, Howard, 16th and 9th streets.
